why: Trend
Sitting at 99% of its 52-week range — essentially at all-time highs. Strong trend, but very little cushion if it stalls.
Trigger
Chasing calls this close to the top of the range is late-stage; a pullback to $753-758 would be a cleaner entry than paying up here.
Watch
Old support/resistance levels ($744/$753) are stale now that price has run well past them — treat them as a floor to watch on any pullback, not a current ceiling.
Trend
Index is grinding to new highs — fading strength this strong is fighting a confirmed uptrend.
Trigger
Only reconsider on a real break back below the old $744 zone, not just a red day near the top.
Catalyst
Stock cratered to a fresh multi-month low near $304 after the Q2 miss (EPS miss despite a revenue beat, negative free cash flow), then clawed back to the $320s-330s over the past week.
Trend
This is a stabilization bounce, not a confirmed reversal — still down hard over the past month. A close back above $340 resistance would strengthen the case.
Trigger
Wait for that $340 reclaim before paying for calls; buying into an unconfirmed bounce is a coin flip.
Momentum
The big down-move already happened — shares are 9%+ off recent lows now. Chasing more short here is late, not early.
Trigger
Only worth revisiting on a fresh break of the $304 low, not on residual bearishness from two weeks ago.
Catalyst
Q2 earnings (Aug 3) beat big — EPS $0.41 vs $0.33 est., revenue growth ~94% YoY, US commercial revenue +149% YoY — and the stock popped ~15% on it.
Momentum
That's a large, fast move already in the books. Buying calls right after a 15% earnings gap is chasing, with valuation concerns (elevated price-to-sales) still in the background.
Trigger
A pullback and higher-low around $128-132 would be a healthier entry than paying up here.
Catalyst
The earnings beat was unambiguous and the market rewarded it hard — fading fresh bullish momentum the day after a blowout quarter is a bad risk/reward.
Trigger
Only worth a look if it gives back the entire earnings gap and breaks back below $128.
Trend
Still drifting in the same tight range — no breakout trigger yet, and no fresh catalyst since the last update.
Trigger
A reclaim of $328-332 on volume would flip this to an actual lean.
Trend
Mild pullback, but $320 support is still holding — no confirmed breakdown.
Trigger
Only worth a put if $320 gives way cleanly, not on a single red day.

Trend

Trigger
Wait for a reclaim of $620+ before treating this as a call setup.

Trigger
